records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Media
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no first project, only 1 invite, and an open blocking ticket (tick_20218589d451) where the Slack page just spins across 3 browsers. Customer engagement is reactive friction (bulk-invite complaint, tick_5f9f1e0567f1); no customer-initiated progress since [email:64b3fcfa]. Unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely but possible given Team plan intent.

draft.subject: Your Slack integration ticket, and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for flagging the Slack integration page spinning across three browsers — your ticket is still open and I'm staying on it, and I'll come back to you on the status page question too.

In the meantime, you don't have to wait on that to get value: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is the quickest way to see how Wrenfield fits Harbor Media. And as mentioned, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'll set up that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
